description: Four sliders, each putting out a steady voltage from 0V to 10V, with a text area for writing down what they are patched to

params.text: Sets the voltage at the output of the matching letter, 0V at the bottom of its travel and 10V at the top

outputs.text: Carries the voltage set by the slider of the matching letter, 0V to 10V

notes: the dark area on the panel takes typed text, for labelling the four sliders; the text is saved with the patch
shift-dragging up or down on the module name changes the colour of the panel, and holding ctrl as well makes the change finer
